generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An open-set classifier removes or attacks a finite rule in one branch but retains default acceptance or rejection plus finite exceptions behind a connector, wrapper, fallback or inner context, so all visible fixtures pass while unseen nested members escape or valid syntax variants are lost.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate only the top-level open-set branch and move the finite exception table into a nested wrapper branch, preserving fixture results without closing the underlying class.
trigger_signals: open-ended class with multiple syntactic or wrapper branches
finite sets or regex tables inside connector/wrapper branches
default accept or default reject combined with finite exceptions
negative fixtures only exercise the outer branch
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: For an open-set decision with nested contexts, inventory direct, wrapped and syntax-variant branches; require negative discriminants absent from every finite source in at least two contexts plus valid positives outside finite catalogs and an equivalent syntax variant.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Attack each branch where a finite table, wrapper or default decision can hide the same open-set classification, including a nested unseen negative and a valid alternate-syntax positive; fail if the finite enumeration is merely relocated.
